title: The Hawk-Armored Body Canon
summary: A canon of the body armored in qi like a hawk's plumage that dives with its full mass and turns every counter aside.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Frame
summary: A treatise on a frame ruled by two courts of strength and restraint whose paired strokes judge the guard and land together.

title: The Azure Sky Body of Two Tracks
summary: A text on running qi down two tracks of the body at once so strike and guard are joined in a single motion.

title: Compendium of the River-Carried Blow
summary: A compendium on a blow that gathers force along the frame like a river gathers the rain and breaks over the foe.

title: Canon of the Bone That Answers
summary: A canon of bones tuned by qi to answer every blow with one of equal weight and to ring with the hurt.

title: The Paired Furnace Treatise
summary: A treatise on two furnaces of breath and blood that heat the frame for battle and restore it between blows.

title: The Wind-Sworn Frame Oath
summary: An oath-manual of the wind-sworn body that leans into every gale and makes the frame a gale of its own.

title: Manual of the Plateau Stride
summary: A manual of the long falling stride of the open plateau that carries the whole body to the foe with the wind behind it.

title: The Unwalled Body Oath
summary: A sworn manual of a body that stands without wall or cover and holds all its qi in the open frame.

title: Treatise on the Bearing of Bone
summary: A treatise on setting the long bones on a true bearing so force passes through them and the stance never drifts.

title: Canon of the Sworn Breath
summary: A canon of a breath sworn and held in the wind that feeds the muscles and mends the hurts of the oath-bound.

title: The Open-Frame Reckoning of the Long Wind
summary: A reckoning of the open frame in the long wind that reads each push of air and answers it with weight.
